title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::

items.text: I am interested in speaking English.
I want to interpret for people who can't speak English in my future.
I want to be an interpreter.
A few years ago, when Queen Elizabeth came to Korea, she came with
The interpreter was very professional and had a big impression on me.
There are many reasons why I want to become an interpreter.
First, English is a very widely used language in the world.
So I know that English is important.
Second, I want to translate many books.
I want to write books in English too.
I will study English everyday, by practicing listening and speaking English.
I will also go to an English Academy.
When I grow up I want to go abroad to study English.
If I do my best, I am sure my dream will come true.
I really want to be a great interpreter.
